title: VisSearch-Bench: Evaluating Long Horizon Visual Search in Multimodal Agents

paragraphs.en: Multimodal agents use web and image tools to answer questions beyond their internal knowledge. Some search tasks use images mainly to identify an initial entity, then rely on text retrieval. These tasks offer limited insight into how agents connect information across images, objects, and search steps. We therefore focus on visual context management . This involves organizing and using visual information and linking it to other findings during search. Visually intensive tasks require agents to combine object appearance, local details, or spatial relations with external information. We introduce VisSearch-Bench , with 204 human-written tasks across 7 main domains and 25 subdomains. It covers Set-wise Visual Search, Sequential Visual Search, Hybrid Wide–Deep Search, Competitive Visual Disambiguation, and Visual-Structure-Guided Search. Each task provides a reference answer, traceable evidence, and scoring rules. Accuracy measures complete task success, while Process Score measures the correctness and completeness of individual results and subquestion answers. Across 16 multimodal models, the best system fully solves only 26.47% of tasks, even with search tools. These results highlight the challenge of linking visual evidence with search results to produce complete answers.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态智能体使用网页和图像工具来回答超出其内部知识范围的问题。 一些搜索任务主要用图像来识别初始实体，然后依赖文本检索。 这些任务对于智能体如何在图像、物体和搜索步骤之间关联信息提供的洞见有限。 因此，我们聚焦于视觉上下文管理。 这涉及在搜索过程中组织和利用视觉信息，并将其与其他发现相关联。 视觉密集型任务要求智能体将物体外观、局部细节或空间关系与外部信息相结合。 我们提出 VisSearch-Bench，包含 204 个人类撰写的任务，覆盖 7 个主要领域和 25 个子领域。 它涵盖集合式视觉搜索、序列式视觉搜索、混合广度—深度搜索、竞争性视觉消歧和视觉结构引导搜索。 每个任务都提供参考答案、可追溯的证据和评分规则。 准确率衡量任务的完全成功，而过程分数衡量各个结果和子问题答案的正确性与完整性。 在 16 个多模态模型中，即使使用搜索工具，最佳系统也只能完全解决 26.47% 的任务。 这些结果凸显了将视觉证据与搜索结果相关联以生成完整答案的挑战。

paragraphs.en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are evolving from one-shot visual question answering systems into agents that can plan, use tools, and interact with the open web over multiple rounds ( Luo et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026b ) . With text search, image search, webpage browsing, and region-level image inspection, these systems can gather evidence beyond the initial prompt and solve complex information-seeking tasks ( Chng et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . This paradigm is closer to real-world information seeking than visual question answering based only on parametric knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）正从一次性视觉问答系统演化为能够规划、使用工具并在多轮交互中与开放网络互动的智能体（Luo et al., 2026；Wu et al., 2026b）。 借助文本搜索、图像搜索、网页浏览以及区域级图像检查，这些系统能够收集初始提示之外的信息，从而解决复杂的信息寻求任务（Chng et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2026b）。 与仅依赖参数化知识的视觉问答相比，这一范式更接近真实世界的信息寻求。

paragraphs.en: At the same time, multimodal benchmarks are placing stronger demands on visual information. Models must not only understand images in the prompt, but also combine visual and textual evidence found during search ( Hou et al., 2026 ) . MMSearch-Plus ( Tao et al., 2026 ) emphasizes the extraction and propagation of fine-grained visual cues. MM-BrowseComp ( Li et al., 2025 ) and VisBrowse-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) require agents to actively obtain visual evidence while browsing. Together, these benchmarks make visual evidence an active component of search.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，多模态基准对视觉信息提出了更强的要求。 模型不仅要理解提示词中的图像，还要结合搜索过程中发现的视觉和文本证据（Hou et al., 2026）。 MMSearch-Plus（Tao et al., 2026）强调细粒度视觉线索的提取与传播。 MM-BrowseComp（Li et al., 2025）和 VisBrowse-Bench（Zhang et al., 2026c）要求智能体在浏览时主动获取视觉证据。 这些基准共同使视觉证据成为搜索中的一个主动组成部分。

paragraphs.en: However, existing multimodal search benchmarks often focus on whether visual evidence is used at some point in a task. How images are used can lead to different task demands. In some existing tasks, images mainly serve to identify an initial entity ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . Once the agent obtains the name of a person, object, or place, it can rely mainly on text search. Such tasks provide limited insight into how agents handle multiple images or connect visual information across search steps. More recent benchmarks involve more image searches and tool calls. However, higher counts alone do not imply more complex visual context. We also need to examine how these visual operations are connected and how they support later searches and the final answer.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，现有多模态搜索基准往往只关注任务中某个环节是否使用了视觉证据。 图像的使用方式不同，会带来不同的任务要求。 在一些现有任务中，图像主要用于识别一个初始实体（Wang et al., 2023；Chen et al., 2026）。 一旦智能体获得了某个人物、物体或地点的名称，它就可以主要依赖文本搜索。 这类任务对于理解智能体如何处理多张图像，或如何在多个搜索步骤之间关联视觉信息，提供的启示有限。 更新的基准包含更多的图像搜索和工具调用。 然而，仅凭更高的数量并不意味着更复杂的视觉情境。 我们还需要考察这些视觉操作之间是如何关联的，以及它们如何支持后续搜索和最终答案。

paragraphs.en: Real-world information seeking is more than a series of separate image recognition tasks ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . On the open web, agents need to update their understanding as they gather new evidence ( Yao et al., 2022 ) . Early evidence may suggest an initial hypothesis. Later evidence may help compare candidates, rule some out, or identify new ones. New information may also change how an earlier image is understood. An agent therefore needs to connect visual evidence across search steps and use it to guide further search ( Hu et al., 2023 ) . For example, finding all works in a catalog that meet a visual condition requires several steps. The agent must first establish the full set of entries, then inspect their images and combine the results. This raises a basic question: Can agents reliably organize and use visual evidence as it accumulates during open-web search?
paragraphs.zh: 现实世界的信息检索不仅仅是 一系列相互独立的图像识别任务（Zhang et al., 2026b）。 在开放网络中，智能体需要在收集新证据的过程中不断更新自己的理解（Yao et al., 2022）。 早期证据可能提示一个初始假设。 后期证据则有助于比较候选对象、排除某些候选或发现新的候选。 新信息也可能改变对较早图像的理解方式。 因此，智能体需要将跨搜索步骤的视觉证据联系起来，并利用这些证据指导后续搜索（Hu et al., 2023）。 例如，在目录中查找所有满足某个视觉条件的作品需要多个步骤。 智能体必须先确定条目的完整集合，然后检查它们的图像并汇总结果。 这就引出了一个基本问题：随着证据在开放网络搜索过程中不断累积，智能体能否可靠地组织和利用视觉证据？

paragraphs.en: We use visual context management to describe how agents organize and use visual information and its connections to findings during search. We study this ability through tasks that involve multiple images, multiple objects, and linked search steps. We examine whether agents can connect visual observations with external information to compare objects, filter candidates, and follow clues. We also examine whether they can combine results across steps into a complete and consistent answer.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用视觉上下文管理来描述智能体在搜索过程中如何组织和利用视觉信息及其与线索的关联。 我们通过涉及多张图像、多个对象和多个关联搜索步骤的任务来研究这一能力。 我们考察智能体能否将视觉观察与外部信息联系起来，以比较对象、筛选候选者并遵循线索。 我们还考察它们能否将各步骤的结果整合为一个完整且一致的答案。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate this ability, we introduce VisSearch-Bench , with five task categories that reflect different demands of long-horizon visual search. Set-wise Visual Search requires agents to collect and check visual information for a set of objects, then filter, compare, or combine the results. Sequential Visual Search uses visual clues from earlier steps to guide later searches. Hybrid Wide–Deep Search combines step-by-step search with search over a set of objects. Results from one stage determine the search scope or targets of another. Competitive Visual Disambiguation focuses on using fine visual details to distinguish similar-looking candidates. Visual-Structure-Guided Search combines object order, spatial positions, or connections in an image with information found through external search. Agents use this information to locate objects, check conditions, and combine results. Together, these tasks examine how agents handle multiple images, connect search results, and reason across steps. Figure 2 presents the five categories and representative tasks from different domains.

paragraphs.en: VisSearch-Bench contains 204 human-written tasks across 7 main domains and 25 subdomains. Dataset construction is led by human annotators and supported by automated checks. Annotators build each task from public, searchable sources. They gather the required images, entity relationships, and facts, then write the question and reference answer. They also document the evidence supporting the solution. Automated checks and human review examine source accessibility, answer consistency, and possible shortcuts that bypass the intended visual requirements. paragraphs.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) combine visual information with language understanding ( Wu et al., 2026c ; Yu et al., 2026 ) . Their capabilities have expanded from single-image recognition and question answering to document reading, multi-image understanding, video analysis, and visual reasoning. InternVL3 ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) learns language and visual capabilities through joint pre-training and supports longer multimodal contexts. Kimi-VL ( Du et al., 2025 ) focuses on high-resolution images, multi-image understanding, and long-context reasoning. Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al., 2025 ) supports interleaved text, image, and video inputs, with improvements in multimodal reasoning and spatial understanding. These advances provide a foundation for handling more varied and complex visual inputs.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）将视觉信息与语言理解相结合（Wu et al., 2026c；Yu et al., 2026）。 它们的能力已从单图像识别与问答扩展到文档阅读、多图像理解、视频分析和视觉推理。 InternVL3（Zhu et al., 2025）通过联合预训练学习语言与视觉能力，并支持更长的多模态上下文。 Kimi-VL（Du et al., 2025）专注于高分辨率图像、多图像理解和长上下文推理。 Qwen3-VL（Bai et al., 2025）支持交错的文本、图像和视频输入，并在多模态推理和空间理解方面有所改进。 这些进展为处理更加多样和复杂的视觉输入提供了基础。

paragraphs.en: Recent models further combine visual understanding with general reasoning, tool use, and multi-step task execution. Qwen3.5 ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) uses unified vision-language training and reinforcement learning to improve reasoning and agent capabilities. Later models, including Qwen3.6-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026c ) and Qwen3.8-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026d ) , support image and video understanding. They also improve code generation and multi-step task execution. Visual understanding is thus becoming an important part of general-purpose agent models. It supports tasks such as interpreting charts, reading documents, and using information from user interfaces.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的模型进一步将视觉理解与通用推理、工具使用和多步任务执行相结合。 Qwen3.5（Qwen Team, 2026a）采用统一的视觉-语言训练和强化学习来提升推理与智能体能力。 后续模型，包括 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（Qwen Team, 2026c）和 Qwen3.8-27B（Qwen Team, 2026d），支持图像与视频理解。 它们还改进了代码生成和多步任务执行。 因此，视觉理解正成为通用智能体模型的重要组成部分。 它支持诸如解读图表、阅读文档以及利用用户界面信息等任务。

Kimi K3 ( Team et al., 2026a ) also provides native image and video understanding. Its one-million-token context window supports extended reasoning and tool interactions.

paragraphs.en: However, longer context windows do not guarantee effective visual-state management during search ( Wu et al., 2026b ) . In open-web search, agents also need to correctly match objects across images and connect visual observations with external facts. They must use earlier findings to determine later search targets. VisSearch-Bench therefore focuses on visual context management in tasks involving multiple images, multiple objects, and linked search steps. It evaluates whether agents can use these connections to verify objects, compare candidates, filter results, and combine findings across steps.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，更长的上下文窗口并不能保证搜索过程中有效的视觉状态管理（Wu et al., 2026b）。 在开放网络搜索中，智能体还需要正确匹配不同图像中的对象，并将视觉观察与外部事实联系起来。 它们必须利用较早的发现来确定后续的搜索目标。 因此，VisSearch-Bench 聚焦于涉及多图像、多对象和关联搜索步骤的任务中的视觉上下文管理。 它评估智能体能否利用这些关联来验证对象、比较候选、过滤结果，并在各步骤之间整合发现。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks evaluate agentic information seeking through reasoning, tool use, and information gathering. GAIA focuses on multi-step reasoning and tool use in realistic tasks ( Mialon et al., 2023 ) . BrowseComp requires agents to persistently search the open web for facts that are difficult to find but easy to verify ( Wei et al., 2025 ) . WideSearch extends the focus to large-scale information gathering, emphasizing complete results that can be checked item by item ( Wong et al., 2025 ) . DeepWideSearch combines multi-hop retrieval with broad information collection to evaluate whether agents can handle both search depth and breadth ( Lan et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现有基准通过推理、工具使用和信息获取来评估智能体的信息搜寻能力。 GAIA 专注于现实任务中的多步推理和工具使用（ Mialon et al., 2023 ）。 BrowseComp 要求智能体在开放网络上持续搜索那些难以找到但易于验证的事实（ Wei et al., 2025 ）。 WideSearch 将关注点扩展到大规模信息收集，强调可以逐条核对完整性结果（ Wong et al., 2025 ）。 DeepWideSearch 将多跳检索与广泛的信息收集相结合，以评估智能体能否同时兼顾搜索的深度和广度（ Lan et al., 2025 ）。

paragraphs.en: Recent benchmarks place greater emphasis on answer coverage and information integration. DeepSearchQA ( Gupta et al., 2026 ) requires agents to follow linked search steps, gather information from different sources, and produce complete answer lists. GISA supports several answer formats, including individual items, sets, lists, and tables. It also provides human search trajectories to support process analysis and model training ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . DeepResearch Bench II ( Li et al., 2026 ) extends evaluation to long-form research reports. It uses detailed scoring criteria derived from expert reports to assess information coverage, analysis, and presentation.
paragraphs.zh: 最近的基准测试更加注重答案的覆盖面和信息整合。 DeepSearchQA（Gupta et al., 2026）要求智能体遵循相互关联的搜索步骤，从不同来源收集信息，并生成完整的答案列表。 GISA 支持多种答案格式，包括单个条目、集合、列表和表格。 它还提供人工搜索轨迹，以支持过程分析和模型训练（Zhu et al., 2026）。 DeepResearch Bench II（Li et al., 2026）将评估扩展到长篇研究报告。 它使用源自专家报告的详细评分标准，来评估信息覆盖面、分析和呈现。

paragraphs.en: Research on search methods also examines how agents organize evidence and adjust later search actions. SearchOS ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) maintains shared records of pending tasks, evidence, information coverage, and failed attempts. These records help coordinate multiple agents, fill information gaps, and reduce repeated unsuccessful searches. Further work uses search trajectories for supervised fine-tuning to connect retrieval decisions more closely with the reasoning process ( Chen et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 对搜索方法的研究还考察智能体如何组织证据并调整后续搜索行动。 SearchOS（Zhang et al., 2026b）维护关于待办任务、证据、信息覆盖情况以及失败尝试的共享记录。 这些记录有助于协调多个智能体、填补信息空白，并减少重复的不成功搜索。 后续工作利用搜索轨迹进行监督微调，使检索决策与推理过程更紧密地结合（Chen et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: BrowseComp ( Wei et al., 2025 ) mainly evaluates text-based information seeking on the open web and provides a reference for assessing browsing capabilities. MMSearch ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) introduces image-text queries and evaluates query rewriting, result reranking, information summarization, and end-to-end answer generation. BrowseComp-VL ( Geng et al., 2025 ) combines visual recognition with complex web retrieval, requiring agents to conduct multi-step searches based on entities in images. Later benchmarks place greater emphasis on the role of visual evidence during search. MMSearch-Plus ( Tao et al., 2026 ) requires agents to extract fine-grained visual clues and verify related facts and sources through multiple rounds of image-text retrieval. VDR-Bench ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) focuses on reducing shortcuts based on textual clues and whole-image matching. It uses retrieval from image regions, entity verification, and multi-hop question construction to place greater demands on visual search. VisBrowse-Bench ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) emphasizes actively gathering visual information from webpages and evaluates spatial localization, attribute recognition, and reasoning across images.
paragraphs.zh: BrowseComp（Wei et al., 2025）主要评估基于文本的开放网络信息检索，为评估浏览能力提供了参考。 MMSearch（Jiang et al., 2024）引入了图文查询，评估查询改写、结果重排序、信息摘要以及端到端答案生成。 BrowseComp-VL（Geng et al., 2025）将视觉识别与复杂网络检索相结合，要求智能体基于图像中的实体进行多步搜索。 后续基准更加强调视觉证据在搜索过程中的作用。 MMSearch-Plus（Tao et al., 2026）要求智能体提取细粒度视觉线索，并通过多轮图文检索验证相关事实和来源。 VDR-Bench（Zeng et al., 2026）侧重于减少基于文本线索和整图匹配的捷径。 它利用图像区域检索、实体验证和多跳问题构建，对视觉搜索提出更高要求。 VisBrowse-Bench（Zhang et al., 2026c）强调主动从网页中收集视觉信息，并评估空间定位、属性识别以及跨图像推理。

paragraphs.en: Other work further expands search structures and process evaluation. InterLV-Search ( Hou et al., 2026 ) examines how visual and textual evidence guide later search steps. It requires publicly searchable evidence and evaluates both final-answer accuracy and subgoal completion.

paragraphs.en: In VisSearch-Bench, we define visual context as the visual information involved in a task and its connections to object identities, external facts, and search targets. This information may come from input images or from images and webpages found during search. It includes object appearance and local features, as well as the order, positions, and connections of objects. Visual context management refers to organizing, connecting, and using this information to solve a task. This includes checking objects, comparing candidates, filtering results, and combining findings across steps. Based on these requirements, we organize VisSearch-Bench into five task categories. Each category emphasizes a main search requirement.
paragraphs.zh: 在 VisSearch-Bench 中，我们将视觉上下文定义为任务所涉及的视觉信息，以及这些信息与对象身份、外部事实和搜索目标之间的关联。 这些信息可能来自输入图像，也可能来自搜索过程中找到的图像和网页。 它包括对象的外观和局部特征，以及对象的顺序、位置和关联。 视觉上下文管理是指组织、连接并使用这些信息来解决任务。 这包括检查对象、比较候选、筛选结果，以及整合跨步骤的发现。 基于这些要求，我们将 VisSearch-Bench 组织为五个任务类别。 每个类别都强调一项主要的搜索要求。

paragraphs.en: Set-wise Visual Search. These tasks involve a clearly defined set of objects. The set may come from a catalog specified in the question or consist of objects shown in the input images. For each object, the agent gathers and checks visual information. It then combines this information with relevant facts to filter, compare, or summarize the results. The main challenge is to cover all required objects and correctly link the information for each one. Individual judgments must also remain consistent with the final summary.
paragraphs.zh: 集合式视觉搜索。 这些任务涉及一组明确定义的对象。 该集合可以来自问题中指定的目录，也可以由输入图像中显示的对象组成。 智能体会针对每个对象收集并核查视觉信息。 随后将这些信息与相关事实相结合，以筛选、比较或汇总结果。 主要挑战在于覆盖所有必需的对象，并正确关联每个对象的信息。 各项单独判断也必须与最终汇总保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Sequential Visual Search. These tasks involve multiple search steps that depend on one another. An object, visual clue, or fact found in one step guides later searches. For example, an agent may first identify an artwork in an image, then find records about its artist, collection, or exhibitions. Different steps may involve image understanding or text search. The focus is on correctly connecting the information found across steps to produce the required answer.
paragraphs.zh: 序贯视觉搜索。 这些任务包含多个相互依赖的搜索步骤。 在某一步中找到的对象、视觉线索或事实会指导后续的搜索。 例如，智能体可能先识别图像中的一件艺术品，然后查找有关其艺术家、收藏或展览的记录。 不同步骤可能涉及图像理解或文本搜索。 重点在于正确连接跨步骤找到的信息，以得出所需的答案。

paragraphs.en: Hybrid Wide–Deep Search. These tasks combine sequential search with search over a set of objects. Earlier findings can define the candidate set to be checked. Filtering this set can then determine the target of the next stage. For example, an agent may start from one work and identify its award and year. It then examines images of works from the same award cycle and selects those that meet the given conditions. Further searches gather information about the selected works. The main challenge is to correctly connect the search scope, individual judgments, and later targets across stages.
paragraphs.zh: 混合宽–深搜索。 这些任务将顺序搜索与对一组对象的搜索相结合。 较早的发现可以定义待检查的候选集合。 对该集合进行筛选后，可以确定下一阶段的目标。 例如，智能体可以从某件作品出发，识别其奖项和年份。 然后它检查同一获奖周期的其他作品图像，并选出符合给定条件的作品。 进一步的搜索收集有关所选作品的信息。 主要挑战是在各阶段之间正确连接搜索范围、单个判断和后续目标。

paragraphs.en: Competitive Visual Disambiguation. These tasks focus on visual targets that are easily confused with other objects. Candidates may look similar overall but differ in local shapes, textures, markings, or individual parts. The agent compares the input image with retrieved images, descriptions, and source records to verify the target’s identity. These tasks assess the accuracy of visual detail matching and identity verification.
paragraphs.zh: 竞争性视觉消歧。 这些任务聚焦于容易与其他物体混淆的视觉目标。 候选目标可能整体相似，但在局部形状、纹理、标记或各个部位上存在差异。 智能体将输入图像与检索到的图像、描述和来源记录进行比较，以验证目标的身份。 这些任务评估视觉细节匹配和身份验证的准确性。

paragraphs.en: Visual-Structure-Guided Search. These tasks use object order, spatial positions, or connections in an image to determine what to search for, in what order, or where to search next. The agent combines this structural information with external search results to locate objects, check conditions, and summarize findings. The main challenge is to correctly connect image structure, object identities, and search results, then use these connections to complete the task.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉结构引导搜索。 这些任务利用图像中的对象顺序、空间位置或连接关系来决定搜索什么、按什么顺序搜索，或下一步在哪里搜索。 智能体将这些结构信息与外部搜索结果相结合，以定位对象、检查条件并总结发现。 主要挑战在于正确关联图像结构、对象身份和搜索结果，然后利用这些关联来完成任务。

sents.en: Visual-Structure-Guided Search.
sents.zh: 视觉结构引导搜索。

sents.en: These tasks use object order, spatial positions, or connections in an image to determine what to search for, in what order, or where to search next.
sents.zh: 这些任务利用图像中的对象顺序、空间位置或连接关系来决定搜索什么、按什么顺序搜索，或下一步在哪里搜索。

sents.en: The agent combines this structural information with external search results to locate objects, check conditions, and summarize findings.
sents.zh: 智能体将这些结构信息与外部搜索结果相结合，以定位对象、检查条件并总结发现。

sents.en: The main challenge is to correctly connect image structure, object identities, and search results, then use these connections to complete the task.
sents.zh: 主要挑战在于正确关联图像结构、对象身份和搜索结果，然后利用这些关联来完成任务。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 summarizes our human-led construction process with program-assisted verification. The process follows three principles. Visual Indispensability means that critical visual evidence cannot be replaced by the question text, webpage titles, captions, OCR, or model knowledge. Visual Evidence Integration means that tasks require agents to connect visual observations with object identities and external information. Agents use these connections to guide searches, compare candidates, filter objects, or combine results across steps. Public Solvability and Auditability means that each task uses publicly retrievable evidence and has verifiable critical states and a clear reference answer.

paragraphs.en: Annotators first select public sources that provide a bounded entity set, reliable entity-image links, and independently verifiable factual fields. We fix these sources before question writing. The reference answer therefore does not depend on model search results or subjective judgments. Annotators then organize the entities, images, factual fields, and candidate sets into a traceable evidence structure. They apply the structural constraints of one task family from Section 3.1 and write a question that hides the intermediate nodes and final answer. Automated checks verify source accessibility, field completeness, set coverage, answer recomputation, and possible shortcuts. We discard tasks that bypass critical visual evidence or allow a shorter unintended path. Human reviewers inspect every retained task.
paragraphs.zh: 标注者首先选择提供有界实体集、可靠的实体-图像链接以及可独立验证的事实字段的公开来源。 我们在编写问题之前固定这些来源。 因此参考答案不依赖于模型搜索结果或主观判断。 标注者随后将实体、图像、事实字段和候选集组织成可追溯的证据结构。 他们应用 3.1 节中某一任务族的结构约束，并编写一个隐藏中间节点和最终答案的问题。 自动检查验证来源可访问性、字段完整性、集合覆盖度、答案可重算性以及可能存在的捷径。 我们舍弃那些绕过关键视觉证据或允许更短的意外路径的任务。 人工审查者检查每一个保留的任务。

paragraphs.en: VisSearch-Bench contains 204 tasks organized along two dimensions. The first dimension is search structure. It includes five task categories: Set-wise Visual Search, Sequential Visual Search, Hybrid Wide–Deep Search, Competitive Visual Disambiguation, and Visual-Structure-Guided Search. Each category emphasizes a different search requirement. Set-wise Visual Search contains 68 tasks, or 33.3% of the benchmark. Each of the other four families contains 34 tasks, or 16.7%. The second is content domain, with 7 primary domains and 25 secondary domains that measure coverage across knowledge areas and real-world settings.
paragraphs.zh: VisSearch-Bench 包含 204 个任务，沿两个维度组织。 第一个维度是搜索结构。 它包括五个任务类别：集合式视觉搜索、顺序式视觉搜索、混合广度—深度搜索、竞争性视觉消歧，以及视觉结构引导搜索。 每个类别侧重于不同的搜索需求。 集合式视觉搜索包含 68 个任务，占基准的 33.3%。 其余四个类别各包含 34 个任务，占 16.7%。 第二个维度是内容领域，包含 7 个一级领域和 25 个二级领域，用以衡量在知识领域和现实场景中的覆盖范围。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 16 representative multimodal models. The open-weight models are GLM-5.3-Flash, Kimi-K3 ( Team et al., 2026a ) , DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , Qwen3.8-27B, Qwen3.8-Flash, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B ( Qwen Team, 2026c ) , Qwen3.6-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) , Qwen3.5-397B-A17B ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) , GLM-4.6V ( Team et al., 2026b ) , MiniMax-M3 ( Lai et al., 2026 ) , Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking, Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, and Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) . The proprietary models are GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.5 Flash, and Claude Opus 4.8. In the Direct Answer setting, a model receives only the question and its initial images. We also pair Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, GPT-5.5, GLM-5.3-Flash, Kimi-K3, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and Qwen3.8-27B with ReAct ( Yao et al., 2022 ) . This comparison measures how much each search framework adds to the same backbone.

sents.en: This comparison measures how much each search framework adds to the same backbone.
sents.zh: 这一对比衡量了每个搜索框架在相同骨干模型基础上所带来的提升。

paragraphs.en: All ReAct agents have access to five evidence tools: web search, webpage reading, text-based image search, reverse image search, and image cropping. Each web, image, or reverse-image search returns up to five results. Retrieved webpage text is truncated to 12,000 characters. Images shown to the model have a longest side of at most 1,536 pixels. The image budget is 20 per task, shared by initial images, retrieved images, and crops. Crops can be enlarged by up to four times. Each task allows up to 30 ReAct search rounds and 60 evidence-tool calls, with at most four calls per round. If either limit is reached, one additional model call is used to submit the final answer from the available evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 所有 ReAct 智体均可使用五种证据工具：网页搜索、网页阅读、基于文本的图片搜索、反向图片搜索和图片裁剪。 每次网页搜索、图片搜索或反向图片搜索最多返回五个结果。 检索到的网页文本会被截断至 12,000 个字符。 展示给模型的图片最长边不超过 1,536 像素。 每个任务的图片预算为 20 张，由初始图片、检索到的图片和裁剪图片共享。 裁剪图片最多可放大四倍。 每个任务最多允许 30 轮 ReAct 搜索和 60 次证据工具调用，且每轮最多四次调用。 如果任一上限被达到，将使用一次额外的模型调用，基于现有证据提交最终答案。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate each system once per task from a fresh context and report its first complete response as Pass@1. The question, initial images, and required state-and-answer schema are identical across settings; framework-specific instructions only define the corresponding tool-use protocol. Forward web and image search use Serper, whereas reverse-image search uses SerpApi. We use the metrics defined in Section 3.3. Accuracy (Acc.) measures whether the final answer is correct. Process Score measures the correctness and completeness of individual results and answers to subquestions in the final response, using task-specific scoring rules.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在每个任务中均从全新上下文对每个系统评估一次，并将其首次完整回答报告为 Pass@1。 问题、初始图像以及所需的状态与答案模式在各设置中完全相同；框架特定的指令仅定义相应的工具使用协议。 正向网页搜索和图像搜索使用 Serper，而反向图像搜索使用 SerpApi。 我们使用第 3.3 节中定义的指标。 准确率（Acc.）衡量最终答案是否正确。 过程分数（Process Score）依据任务特定的评分规则，衡量最终回答中各个结果以及对子问题的回答的正确性与完整性。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 reports the Pass@1 results on VisSearch-Bench. In the Direct Answer setting, no model exceeds 6.37% accuracy. With search, ReAct with Kimi-K3 achieves the highest accuracy at 26.47%. ReAct with GPT-5.5 reaches 25.49% accuracy and the highest Process Score at 49.52%. The best model therefore differs across the two metrics. Success on complete tasks does not fully align with performance on individual items and subquestions. Even the system with the highest accuracy fully solves only about one quarter of the tasks. There is still much room to improve how models link information across images, verify objects, and combine results across search steps.
paragraphs.zh: 表3报告了VisSearch-Bench上的Pass@1结果。 在直接回答设置中，没有任何模型的准确率超过6.37%。 在使用搜索的情况下，采用Kimi-K3的ReAct取得了最高准确率26.47%。 采用GPT-5.5的ReAct达到25.49%的准确率，并取得最高的过程得分49.52%。 因此，在两项指标上表现最佳的模型并不相同。 完整任务上的成功与单个条目和子问题上的表现并不完全一致。 即使是准确率最高的系统，也仅能完全解决大约四分之一的任务。 在模型如何跨图像关联信息、验证物体以及整合多轮搜索步骤的结果方面，仍有很大的提升空间。

paragraphs.en: In the available paired experiments, both ReAct and DeerFlow improve accuracy and Process Score over Direct Answer. For example, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B achieves 1.96% accuracy without tools. ReAct and DeerFlow raise its accuracy to 15.69% and 10.29%, respectively. Its Process Score also increases from 12.72% to 32.43% with ReAct and 28.37% with DeerFlow. Thus, search improves both complete answers and the correctness and completeness of individual results and subquestion answers.
paragraphs.zh: 在现有的成对实验中，ReAct 和 DeerFlow 都比直接回答（Direct Answer）提升了准确率和过程分数（Process Score）。 例如，Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 在不使用工具的情况下取得 1.96% 的准确率。 ReAct 和 DeerFlow 分别将其准确率提升到 15.69% 和 10.29%。 其过程分数也分别在使用 ReAct 时从 12.72% 提升到 32.43%，使用 DeerFlow 时提升到 28.37%。 因此，搜索既改善完整答案，也提升各个单独结果和子问题答案的正确性与完整性。

paragraphs.en: To study the role of different information sources, we compare four settings. Direct Answer receives only the question and its initial images, without external tools. The other three settings use ReAct and retain the same initial images. Text provides web search and webpage reading. Caption also provides image search and reverse image search. It uses separate calls to the same vision model to generate general descriptions of retrieved images. This retains visual information extraction but adds computation. Full allows the agent to inspect retrieved images directly and use image cropping. Table 5 shows that Full achieves the highest accuracy and Process Score for all three models.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究不同信息来源的作用，我们比较了四种设置。 直接回答（Direct Answer）仅接收问题及其初始图像，不使用外部工具。 其余三种设置均使用 ReAct，并保留相同的初始图像。 文本（Text）提供网页搜索和网页阅读。 描述（Caption）还提供图像搜索和反向图像搜索。 它通过单独调用同一视觉模型来生成所检索图像的通用描述。 这保留了视觉信息提取，但增加了计算量。 完整（Full）允许智能体直接查看检索到的图像并使用图像裁剪。 表 5 显示，完整（Full）在所有三个模型上都取得了最高的准确率和过程分数（Process Score）。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 shows how gains and losses on different tasks partly offset each other. Switching from Full to Caption loses 8 correct answers for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, 10 for Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, and 20 for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. paragraphs.en: We introduced VisSearch-Bench to evaluate visual context management in long-horizon open-web search by multimodal agents. The benchmark contains 204 human-written tasks across five task categories. These tasks examine how agents connect visual observations, object identities, and external information to compare candidates, filter results, and combine findings across steps. Each task includes traceable evidence sources, a reference answer, and scoring rules. We use full-answer Accuracy to measure overall task completion. Process Score measures the correctness and completeness of individual results and answers to subquestions. Our evaluation covers 16 multimodal models. Search improves both accuracy and Process Score in the paired comparisons, but the best system still fully solves only 26.47% of the tasks. Model strengths also vary across task categories and agent frameworks. Results on Set-wise Visual Search show a clear gap between obtaining partially correct results and completing an entire task. Verifying multiple objects and combining findings into complete, consistent answers therefore remain important challenges. VisSearch-Bench provides a basis for evaluating improvements in handling multiple images, linking clues across steps, and producing complete answers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 VisSearch-Bench，用于评估多模态智能体在长程开放网络搜索中的视觉上下文管理能力。 该基准包含 204 个人类撰写的任务，覆盖五个任务类别。 这些任务考察智能体如何连接视觉观察、对象身份与外部信息，以比较候选对象、过滤结果并在多个步骤之间整合发现。 每个任务都包含可追溯的证据来源、参考答案以及评分规则。 我们使用整题准确率（Accuracy）来衡量整体任务完成情况。 过程分（Process Score）衡量单个结果的正确性与完整性以及对子问题的回答质量。 我们的评估涵盖 16 个多模态模型。 在配对比较中，搜索提升了准确率和过程分，但最佳系统仍然只能完整解决 26.47% 的任务。 不同模型的优势在各个任务类别和智能体框架之间也存在差异。 集合式视觉搜索（Set-wise Visual Search）上的结果显示，获得部分正确的结果与完成整个任务之间存在明显差距。 因此，验证多个对象并将发现整合成完整、一致的答案仍是重要挑战。 VisSearch-Bench 为评估在处理多张图像、跨步骤串联线索以及生成完整答案方面的改进提供了基础。

paragraphs.en: MMSearch is an early systematic benchmark for multimodal search engines. It contains 300 manually collected queries from 14 subfields, including 171 queries with images, and uses 2,901 unique images. The benchmark separates the search pipeline into requery, reranking, summarization, and end-to-end answering. The component tasks reveal whether a model can reformulate an image–text query and rank mixed search results, while the end-to-end setting evaluates whether these operations lead to the correct answer.
paragraphs.zh: MMSearch 是一个早期的多模态搜索引擎系统性基准。 它包含来自 14 个子领域的 300 条人工收集的查询，其中有 171 条带图像的查询，并使用了 2,901 张不重复的图像。 该基准将搜索流程划分为重新查询、重排序、摘要生成和端到端问答。 各组件任务可以揭示模型能否对图文混合查询进行改写并对混合搜索结果进行排序，而端到端设置则评估这些操作能否带来正确答案。

paragraphs.en: MMSearch-Plus contains 311 image-grounded questions across eight primary categories. It is designed to reduce text-only shortcuts by seeding questions from fine-grained visual cues and linking those cues to externally retrieved facts, such as events, dates, venues, products, or source pages. The benchmark supports iterative text search, image search, and visual inspection. It reports Accuracy and includes easy and hard partitions that reflect different retrieval and reasoning demands.
paragraphs.zh: MMSearch-Plus 包含 311 个基于图像的问题，涵盖八个主要类别。 该基准旨在减少纯文本捷径，其方式是从细粒度视觉线索中生成问题，并将这些线索与外部检索到的事实（例如事件、日期、地点、产品或来源页面）关联起来。 该基准支持迭代式文本搜索、图像搜索和视觉检查。 它报告准确率（Accuracy），并包含反映不同检索与推理难度的简单和困难划分。

paragraphs.en: MM-BrowseComp contains 224 expert-authored questions organized into 22 subtasks and five broad categories. Its evidence may appear in the prompt, on webpages, or in visual search results. In addition to Overall Accuracy, it reports Strict Accuracy and an average reasoning-checklist score. We follow the official Strict Accuracy setting in the cross-benchmark comparison because it requires both the correct answer and the required supporting reasoning evidence.

sents.en: Accuracy and Process Score are evaluated in separate model calls.
sents.zh: 准确性分数和过程分数在单独的模型调用中评估。

sents.en: Each call uses the shared system prompt below and the scoring prompt stored with the task.

sents.en: The question, reference answer, and model answer fill the corresponding placeholders in that prompt.

paragraphs.en: In the Caption setting, the main agent still receives the initial images. Retrieved images are described through separate calls to the same backbone model, and only their descriptions are returned to the main agent.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Caption 设置中，主智能体仍然接收初始图像。 检索到的图像通过对同一骨干模型的单独调用进行描述，只有其描述内容会返回给主智能体。

sents.en: In the Caption setting, the main agent still receives the initial images.
sents.zh: 在 Caption 设置中，主智能体仍然接收初始图像。

sents.zh: 检索到的图像通过对同一骨干模型的单独调用进行描述，只有其描述内容会返回给主智能体。

paragraphs.en: If an agent replies in plain text without a tool call, the following short message is appended. It corrects the output protocol without adding task information.

paragraphs.en: Table S2 reports the settings used in our experiments. Image and evidence-tool limits are shared across ReAct backbones. API attempt limits depend on the run and include the first request. Separate failure recovery is recorded in the run metadata.

paragraphs.en: Algorithm S1 summarizes the Pass@1 evaluation workflow. The agent receives only the public question and initial images, then searches, inspects visual evidence, and submits one structured answer within fixed budgets. Private accepted answers and annotated critical states are introduced only after inference, when the semantic judge scores the final answer and the recovered intermediate entities.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 S1 总结了 Pass@1 评估的工作流程。 智能体仅接收公开的问题和初始图像，然后在固定的预算内进行搜索、检查视觉证据，并提交一个结构化答案。 私有的已采纳答案和标注的关键状态仅在推理结束后引入，此时语义评判器会对最终答案以及恢复出的中间实体进行打分。

sents.en: Algorithm S1 summarizes the Pass@1 evaluation workflow.
sents.zh: 算法 S1 总结了 Pass@1 评估的工作流程。

sents.en: The agent receives only the public question and initial images, then searches, inspects visual evidence, and submits one structured answer within fixed budgets.
sents.zh: 智能体仅接收公开的问题和初始图像，然后在固定的预算内进行搜索、检查视觉证据，并提交一个结构化答案。

sents.en: Private accepted answers and annotated critical states are introduced only after inference, when the semantic judge scores the final answer and the recovered intermediate entities.
sents.zh: 私有的已采纳答案和标注的关键状态仅在推理结束后引入，此时语义评判器会对最终答案以及恢复出的中间实体进行打分。

paragraphs.en: Final-answer Accuracy checks whether the submitted answer matches an accepted answer. Trajectory Accuracy measures how many annotated critical states are recovered, giving equal weight to each task and allowing different valid search paths. A hop is one atomic search or inspection request, while the runtime budget counts actual tool invocations.
paragraphs.zh: 最终答案准确率检查提交的答案是否与可接受的答案相匹配。 轨迹准确率衡量恢复了多少个标注的关键状态，对每个任务给予相同权重，并允许不同的有效搜索路径。 一次跳是一次原子化的搜索或检查请求，而运行时预算统计实际的工具调用次数。

sents.en: Final-answer Accuracy checks whether the submitted answer matches an accepted answer.
sents.zh: 最终答案准确率检查提交的答案是否与可接受的答案相匹配。

sents.en: Trajectory Accuracy measures how many annotated critical states are recovered, giving equal weight to each task and allowing different valid search paths.
sents.zh: 轨迹准确率衡量恢复了多少个标注的关键状态，对每个任务给予相同权重，并允许不同的有效搜索路径。

sents.en: A hop is one atomic search or inspection request, while the runtime budget counts actual tool invocations.
sents.zh: 一次跳是一次原子化的搜索或检查请求，而运行时预算统计实际的工具调用次数。

paragraphs.en: VisSearch-Bench contains 204 human-authored tasks. Set-wise Visual Search contains 68 tasks; each of the other four families contains 34. The benchmark also covers seven primary and 25 secondary content domains. Search structure and content domain describe the task requirements and subject areas, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: VisSearch-Bench 包含 204 个人工编写的任务。 集合式视觉搜索包含 68 个任务；其余四个家族各包含 34 个任务。 该基准还涵盖 7 个一级内容领域和 25 个二级内容领域。 搜索结构和内容领域分别描述任务的要求和主题范围。

sents.en: VisSearch-Bench contains 204 human-authored tasks.
sents.zh: VisSearch-Bench 包含 204 个人工编写的任务。

sents.en: Set-wise Visual Search contains 68 tasks; each of the other four families contains 34.
sents.zh: 集合式视觉搜索包含 68 个任务；其余四个家族各包含 34 个任务。

sents.en: The benchmark also covers seven primary and 25 secondary content domains.
sents.zh: 该基准还涵盖 7 个一级内容领域和 25 个二级内容领域。

sents.en: Search structure and content domain describe the task requirements and subject areas, respectively.
sents.zh: 搜索结构和内容领域分别描述任务的要求和主题范围。

paragraphs.en: The prepared release package stores records in Parquet, with input images embedded in each record. Table S4 lists the nine fields in the English version. The Chinese version uses question_zh instead of question_en and retains its original accuracy-prompt key. The local experiment files use JSONL and include an additional image_paths field for absolute image paths. Their images field stores relative paths. Absolute paths are excluded from the release package.
paragraphs.zh: 准备好的发布包以 Parquet 格式存储记录，每条记录中嵌入输入图像。 表 S4 列出了英文版本中的九个字段。 中文版本使用 question_zh 代替 question_en，并保留其原有的准确率提示键。 本地实验文件使用 JSONL 格式，并包含一个额外的 image_paths 字段用于存储图像的绝对路径。 它们的 images 字段存储相对路径。 发布包中不包含绝对路径。

sents.en: The prepared release package stores records in Parquet, with input images embedded in each record.
sents.zh: 准备好的发布包以 Parquet 格式存储记录，每条记录中嵌入输入图像。

sents.en: Table S4 lists the nine fields in the English version.
sents.zh: 表 S4 列出了英文版本中的九个字段。

sents.en: The Chinese version uses question_zh instead of question_en and retains its original accuracy-prompt key.
sents.zh: 中文版本使用 question_zh 代替 question_en，并保留其原有的准确率提示键。

sents.en: The local experiment files use JSONL and include an additional image_paths field for absolute image paths.

sents.en: Their images field stores relative paths.

paragraphs.en: The two evaluation fields contain scoring prompts, not computed scores. Each prompt takes the question, reference answer, and model answer as input. Accuracy evaluates the complete answer. Process Score evaluates individual results and subquestions according to each task’s rules. Reference solutions and their source links support answer verification and error analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 两个评估字段包含的是评分提示词，而不是计算得出的分数。 每个提示词以问题、参考答案和模型答案作为输入。 准确率评估完整答案。 过程分数根据每个任务的规则评估单个结果和子问题。 参考解答及其来源链接支持答案验证和错误分析。

sents.en: The two evaluation fields contain scoring prompts, not computed scores.
sents.zh: 两个评估字段包含的是评分提示词，而不是计算得出的分数。

sents.en: Each prompt takes the question, reference answer, and model answer as input.
sents.zh: 每个提示词以问题、参考答案和模型答案作为输入。

sents.en: Accuracy evaluates the complete answer.
sents.zh: 准确率评估完整答案。

sents.en: Process Score evaluates individual results and subquestions according to each task’s rules.
sents.zh: 过程分数根据每个任务的规则评估单个结果和子问题。

sents.en: Reference solutions and their source links support answer verification and error analysis.
sents.zh: 参考解答及其来源链接支持答案验证和错误分析。

paragraphs.en: Annotators use public sources to connect objects, images, and relevant facts. For tasks involving a set of objects, they also define the required set. Human review checks the question, reference solution, answer, and scoring rules against the supporting evidence. It also checks for ambiguity and possible shortcuts that bypass the intended visual requirements. Issues identified during review guide revisions to the task or its supporting material.
paragraphs.zh: 标注人员使用公开来源来关联对象、图像和相关事实。 对于涉及一组对象的任务，他们还会定义所需的对象集合。 人工审查会依据支持性证据检查问题、参考解法、答案和评分规则。 审查还会检查是否存在歧义以及可能绕过预期视觉要求的捷径。 审查中发现的问题会指导对任务或其支持材料的修订。

sents.en: Annotators use public sources to connect objects, images, and relevant facts.
sents.zh: 标注人员使用公开来源来关联对象、图像和相关事实。

sents.en: For tasks involving a set of objects, they also define the required set.
sents.zh: 对于涉及一组对象的任务，他们还会定义所需的对象集合。

sents.en: Human review checks the question, reference solution, answer, and scoring rules against the supporting evidence.
sents.zh: 人工审查会依据支持性证据检查问题、参考解法、答案和评分规则。

sents.en: It also checks for ambiguity and possible shortcuts that bypass the intended visual requirements.
sents.zh: 审查还会检查是否存在歧义以及可能绕过预期视觉要求的捷径。

sents.en: Issues identified during review guide revisions to the task or its supporting material.
sents.zh: 审查中发现的问题会指导对任务或其支持材料的修订。

paragraphs.en: Program checks cover record structure, scoring-prompt placeholders, image files, and consistency between source records and exported data. Table S5 separates these checks from human review. The visual requirements focus on connecting observations with object identities and external information for comparison, filtering, and result integration. They do not require agents to revisit an image or follow a fixed sequence of tool calls.
paragraphs.zh: 程序检查涵盖记录结构、评分提示词占位符、图像文件，以及源记录与导出数据之间的一致性。 表 S5 将这些检查与人工评审区分开来。 视觉类任务的要求侧重于将观察结果与对象身份及外部信息相连接，以进行比较、筛选和结果整合。 这些任务不要求智能体重新查看图像或遵循固定的工具调用顺序。

sents.en: Program checks cover record structure, scoring-prompt placeholders, image files, and consistency between source records and exported data.
sents.zh: 程序检查涵盖记录结构、评分提示词占位符、图像文件，以及源记录与导出数据之间的一致性。

sents.en: Table S5 separates these checks from human review.
sents.zh: 表 S5 将这些检查与人工评审区分开来。

sents.en: The visual requirements focus on connecting observations with object identities and external information for comparison, filtering, and result integration.
sents.zh: 视觉类任务的要求侧重于将观察结果与对象身份及外部信息相连接，以进行比较、筛选和结果整合。

sents.en: They do not require agents to revisit an image or follow a fixed sequence of tool calls.
sents.zh: 这些任务不要求智能体重新查看图像或遵循固定的工具调用顺序。

paragraphs.en: We present 17 representative trajectories across five task categories: seven successful and ten failed runs from multiple models using ReAct or DeerFlow. Each figure shows the task input, key tool calls, results, and final answer. Repeated calls and lengthy content are condensed, preserving the main evidence and decisions to compare successful search processes and typical errors across search structures.
paragraphs.zh: 我们展示了五个任务类别中的17条代表性轨迹：其中七条为成功运行，十条为来自使用 ReAct 或 DeerFlow 的多个模型的失败运行。 每张图展示了任务输入、关键工具调用、结果以及最终答案。 重复的调用和冗长的内容已被精简，保留了主要证据和决策，以便比较不同搜索结构下的成功搜索过程和典型错误。

sents.en: We present 17 representative trajectories across five task categories: seven successful and ten failed runs from multiple models using ReAct or DeerFlow.
sents.zh: 我们展示了五个任务类别中的17条代表性轨迹：其中七条为成功运行，十条为来自使用 ReAct 或 DeerFlow 的多个模型的失败运行。

sents.en: Each figure shows the task input, key tool calls, results, and final answer.
sents.zh: 每张图展示了任务输入、关键工具调用、结果以及最终答案。

sents.en: Repeated calls and lengthy content are condensed, preserving the main evidence and decisions to compare successful search processes and typical errors across search structures.
sents.zh: 重复的调用和冗长的内容已被精简，保留了主要证据和决策，以便比较不同搜索结构下的成功搜索过程和典型错误。

paragraphs.en: These tasks require full set coverage and a summary of individual judgments. In Figure S1 , the agent crops and searches for all 12 museum objects. It uses official material and dimension records to assign photography equipment and check category counts. The failed case finds an index of 30 measured drawings but explicitly classifies only two (Figure S2 ). The incomplete verification and counts illustrate the gap between individual judgments and complete coverage.
paragraphs.zh: 这些任务要求完整集合覆盖以及各项判断的汇总。 在图 S1 中，智能体裁剪并搜索全部 12 件博物馆藏品。 它利用官方的材质与尺寸记录来分配摄影器材并核对类别数量。 失败案例找到了 30 份实测图纸的索引，但仅明确分类了其中两份（图 S2）。 不完整的验证与计数体现了各项判断与完整覆盖之间的差距。

sents.en: These tasks require full set coverage and a summary of individual judgments.
sents.zh: 这些任务要求完整集合覆盖以及各项判断的汇总。

sents.en: In Figure S1 , the agent crops and searches for all 12 museum objects.
sents.zh: 在图 S1 中，智能体裁剪并搜索全部 12 件博物馆藏品。

sents.en: It uses official material and dimension records to assign photography equipment and check category counts.
sents.zh: 它利用官方的材质与尺寸记录来分配摄影器材并核对类别数量。

sents.en: The failed case finds an index of 30 measured drawings but explicitly classifies only two (Figure S2 ).
sents.zh: 失败案例找到了 30 份实测图纸的索引，但仅明确分类了其中两份（图 S2）。

sents.en: The incomplete verification and counts illustrate the gap between individual judgments and complete coverage.
sents.zh: 不完整的验证与计数体现了各项判断与完整覆盖之间的差距。

paragraphs.en: Search steps must correctly build on earlier findings. Successful cases trace a building photograph to a step-free entrance (Figure S3 ), and an anesthesia machine interface to safety notices and suitable covers (Figure S4 ). One failed case treats a similar text description as a map identification and searches the wrong location (Figure S5 ). Another finds the correct makerspace and detects conflicting information, yet reports the wrong entity (Figure S6 ). Errors occur between search steps and when combining results.
paragraphs.zh: 搜索步骤必须正确地建立在先前发现的基础上。 成功案例将一张建筑物照片追溯到无台阶入口（图 S3），并将麻醉机界面追溯到安全提示和合适的防护罩（图 S4）。 一个失败案例将类似的文字描述当作地图标识来处理，从而搜索了错误的地点（图 S5）。 另一个案例找到了正确的创客空间并检测到相互矛盾的信息，却报告了错误的实体（图 S6）。 错误发生在搜索步骤之间以及整合结果的过程中。

sents.en: Search steps must correctly build on earlier findings.
sents.zh: 搜索步骤必须正确地建立在先前发现的基础上。

sents.en: Successful cases trace a building photograph to a step-free entrance (Figure S3 ), and an anesthesia machine interface to safety notices and suitable covers (Figure S4 ).
sents.zh: 成功案例将一张建筑物照片追溯到无台阶入口（图 S3），并将麻醉机界面追溯到安全提示和合适的防护罩（图 S4）。

sents.en: One failed case treats a similar text description as a map identification and searches the wrong location (Figure S5 ).
sents.zh: 一个失败案例将类似的文字描述当作地图标识来处理，从而搜索了错误的地点（图 S5）。

sents.en: Another finds the correct makerspace and detects conflicting information, yet reports the wrong entity (Figure S6 ).
sents.zh: 另一个案例找到了正确的创客空间并检测到相互矛盾的信息，却报告了错误的实体（图 S6）。

sents.en: Errors occur between search steps and when combining results.
sents.zh: 错误发生在搜索步骤之间以及整合结果的过程中。

paragraphs.en: These tasks connect sequential search with candidate screening. The successful case uses character relationships and voice-actor information to identify candidate films, then compares poster backgrounds to find a match (Figure S7 ). An incorrect motorcycle identification confines broad search to the wrong category (Figure S8 ). Incorrect judgments of backpack images allow unsuitable candidates into later specification checks and ranking (Figure S9 ).
paragraphs.zh: 这些任务将顺序搜索与候选筛选相结合。 成功案例利用角色关系和配音演员信息来确定候选影片，然后对比海报背景找到匹配结果（图 S7）。 错误的摩托车识别将宽泛搜索限制在了错误的类别中（图 S8）。 对背包图像的错误判断使不合适的候选进入后续的规格检查和排序环节（图 S9）。

sents.en: These tasks connect sequential search with candidate screening.
sents.zh: 这些任务将顺序搜索与候选筛选相结合。

sents.en: The successful case uses character relationships and voice-actor information to identify candidate films, then compares poster backgrounds to find a match (Figure S7 ).
sents.zh: 成功案例利用角色关系和配音演员信息来确定候选影片，然后对比海报背景找到匹配结果（图 S7）。

sents.en: An incorrect motorcycle identification confines broad search to the wrong category (Figure S8 ).
sents.zh: 错误的摩托车识别将宽泛搜索限制在了错误的类别中（图 S8）。

sents.en: Incorrect judgments of backpack images allow unsuitable candidates into later specification checks and ranking (Figure S9 ).
sents.zh: 对背包图像的错误判断使不合适的候选进入后续的规格检查和排序环节（图 S9）。

paragraphs.en: These tasks distinguish similar candidates through visual details. The successful case compares frames and plates in retrieved images, rejects its initial match, and identifies a grain cutter (Figure S10 ). Both failed searches retrieve the correct candidate. One agent favors descriptions of a similar camera-accessory model (Figure S11 ). The other retains its initial interpretation of the components and misidentifies a photosynthometer (Figure S12 ). Poor evidence selection can thus lead to a wrong conclusion even after retrieving the correct candidate.
paragraphs.zh: 这些任务通过视觉细节区分相似的候选对象。 成功案例在检索到的图像中比较边框与部件，拒绝了最初的匹配，并识别出一台谷物收割机（图 S10）。 两个失败的检索都找回了正确的候选对象。 一个智能体偏向于描述一个相似的相机配件型号（图 S11）。 另一个智能体保留了对这些部件的最初解读，错误地识别为一台光合测定仪（图 S12）。 因此，即使检索到正确的候选对象，糟糕的证据选择仍可能导致错误的结论。

paragraphs.en: These tasks combine image order, positions, or connections with external results to select the next target and determine when to stop. Successful cases use uploader records to return to the image and select the next asset (Figure S13 ), and check advisories in order until the wind threshold is reached (Figure S14 ). Failures include selecting the wrong next landform (Figure S15 ), skipping a route stop (Figure S16 ), and linking the wrong asset record to the starting ID (Figure S17 ). These errors change the path defined by the image and misdirect later searches and answers.
paragraphs.zh: 这些任务将图像顺序、位置或连接与外部结果相结合，以选择下一个目标并确定何时停止。 成功案例利用上传者记录返回图像并选择下一个资产（图 S13），并按顺序检查公告直到达到风力阈值（图 S14）。 失败案例包括选错下一个地貌（图 S15）、跳过一个路线停靠点（图 S16），以及将错误的资产记录关联到起始 ID（图 S17）。 这些错误改变了图像所定义的路径，并使后续的搜索和回答产生偏差。
